package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"sync"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for gin_context_copy_for_each_item_fanout: Gin handlers that call c.Copy() once per loop iteration before goroutine fanout.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.

func FanoutHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	items := []string{"item1", "item2", "item3", "item4", "item5"}
	var wg sync.WaitGroup

	for _, item := range items {
		wg.Add(1)
		copied := c.Copy()
		go func(item string, ctx *gin.Context) {
			defer wg.Done()
			status := processItem(ctx, item)
			ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"item": item, "status": status})
		}(item, copied)
	}
	wg.Wait()
}

func processItem(c *gin.Context, item string) string {
	if item != "" {
		return "ok"
	}
	return "empty"
}
